vessel-00.title: Vessel 00
vessel-00.description: Vessel 00 is a mysterious spacecraft connected to the origins of the Automatons. Intelligence recovered from Database One revealed that the vessel departed Cyberstan in 2180, four years before the beginning of the Second Galactic War. Its destination and cargo records were erased, while Automaton records refer to Vessel 00 as their 'seed' or 'origin,' making it one of the most important clues concerning the true origin of the Automaton Legion.

database-one.title: Database One
database-one.description: Database One was the codename for a massive and heavily encrypted Automaton Data Center located on Wasat. Helldivers fought through Wezen and Vega Bay to reach Wasat and successfully captured the facility in June 2184. The enormous archive revealed information about an Automaton terraforming project on Cyberstan and contained repeated references to several mysterious subjects, including Vessel 00, Nucleus, and The Final Collective. Much of the recovered information remained encrypted and required extensive analysis by Super Earth.

nucleus.title: Nucleus
nucleus.description: Nucleus is a mysterious term repeatedly discovered within the encrypted files of Database One. In October 2185, Super Earth located an encryption key on Aesir Pass that could have unlocked the Nucleus files. Helldivers instead secured the competing Vessel 00 encryption key on Menkent, causing the Nucleus data to be lost. The true nature and significance of Nucleus therefore remain unknown.

the-final-collective.title: The Final Collective
the-final-collective.description: The Final Collective is a mysterious term recovered from Database One, the massive Automaton data center captured on Wasat. It appeared repeatedly alongside other classified subjects including Vessel 00 and Nucleus. Unlike Vessel 00, no confirmed intelligence has yet revealed what The Final Collective actually refers to. Its identity, purpose, and significance remain unknown.

jet-brigade.title: Jet Brigade
jet-brigade.description: The Jet Brigade is a specialized Automaton assault division equipped with reverse-engineered jump-pack technology. Designed as a rapid invasion force, the Brigade uses its enhanced mobility to overwhelm planets before moving on to its next target. It first appeared during the Automaton campaign to locate the Democracy Space Station project and has since returned in multiple offensives. Later versions of the Jet Brigade expanded beyond infantry to include jump-pack-equipped Devastators and Hulks.

cyborg-legion.title: Cyborg Legion
cyborg-legion.description: The Cyborg Legion is an Automaton-aligned subfaction descended from the Cyborgs of the First Galactic War. They returned to active combat during Operation Valid Pretext on Cyberstan and fight alongside Automaton forces.

incineration-corps.title: Incineration Corps
incineration-corps.description: The Incineration Corps is an Automaton assault formation specialized in incendiary warfare. Its forces use flamethrowers, incendiary ammunition, and other fire-based weapons and have been responsible for burning Super Earth colonies during large-scale offensives.

trooper.title: Trooper
trooper.description: The Trooper is a light Automaton infantry unit and one of the most common soldiers fielded by the Automaton Legion. Armed with a Fusion SMG and explosive grenades, Troopers patrol Automaton territory, defend outposts and objectives, deploy from Fabricators and Bot Drops, and can call for reinforcements using a flare launcher. Specialized variants have also been deployed by forces such as the Jet Brigade and Incineration Corps.

commissar.title: Commissar
commissar.description: The Commissar is a light Automaton squad leader commonly found leading patrols and guarding Automaton positions. Armed with a Fusion Pistol, Heat Blade, and grenades, it can engage Helldivers at both ranged and close quarters. Commissars can also launch signal flares to summon Bot Drop reinforcements. The Jet Brigade fields a specialized Commissar variant equipped with a jump pack.

brawler.title: Brawler
brawler.description: The Brawler is a light Automaton infantry unit specialized for close-quarters combat. Armed with twin Heat Blades, Brawlers aggressively advance on Helldivers and attack once they reach melee range. They can appear in patrols, Bot Drops, Automaton Outposts, objectives, and emerge from Automaton Fabricators. Like other light Automatons, Brawlers can also launch signal flares to call in Bot Drop reinforcements.

rocket-raider.title: Rocket Raider
rocket-raider.description: The Rocket Raider is a light Automaton infantry unit equipped with a Portable Launcher firing explosive rockets. It typically engages Helldivers from medium to long range, firing a rocket before reloading and repositioning away from approaching enemies. Rocket Raiders can appear in patrols, Bot Drops, Automaton Outposts, objectives, and Fabricators, and can launch signal flares to call for Bot Drop reinforcements. The Incineration Corps also fields a specialized incendiary variant equipped with a Portable Fusion Cannon.

marauder.title: Marauder
marauder.description: The Marauder is a reinforced light Automaton infantry unit and a more heavily protected variant of the Trooper. Armed with a Fusion SMG and explosive grenades, Marauders engage Helldivers with five-round bursts while attempting to maintain distance from approaching targets. They can deploy from Bot Drops and Fabricators, patrol Automaton territory, guard objectives and outposts, and launch signal flares to summon Bot Drop reinforcements.

mg-raider.title: MG Raider
mg-raider.description: The MG Raider is a reinforced light Automaton infantry unit equipped with a Light Fusion Repeater, explosive grenades, and a volatile backpack-mounted power supply. It delivers sustained suppressive fire at medium range and can call in Bot Drop reinforcements using a signal flare. Damaging its power backpack can cause a violent explosion capable of killing the MG Raider and damaging nearby units. The Jet Brigade also fields a specialized MG Raider variant equipped with a jump pack.

berserker.title: Berserker
berserker.description: The Berserker is a durable, medium-sized Automaton designed for close-quarters combat. Equipped with a Meatsaw on each arm, it relentlessly advances toward Helldivers to attack at melee range. Berserkers commonly deploy in groups through Bot Drops, patrols, Automaton Outposts, and objectives, where their durability and aggressive pursuit can force Helldivers out of defensive positions.

devastator.title: Devastator
devastator.description: The Devastator is a medium-armored Automaton infantry unit equipped with a double-barreled Fusion Assault Cannon. It steadily advances while firing bursts at Helldivers and can use powerful melee attacks at close range. Devastators appear in patrols, Bot Drops, Automaton Outposts, and objectives, and can also be deployed directly from the undercarriage of a Factory Strider. The standard Devastator design serves as the basis for several specialized variants, including the Heavy Devastator and Rocket Devastator.

heavy-devastator.title: Heavy Devastator
heavy-devastator.description: The Heavy Devastator is a medium Automaton and specialized variant of the Devastator equipped with a rapid-firing Fusion Repeater and a large ballistic shield. It steadily advances while unleashing sustained volleys of fire, using its shield to block incoming attacks and bash nearby Helldivers. Heavy Devastators can appear in patrols, Bot Drops, Automaton Outposts, objectives, and Minor Places of Interest.

rocket-devastator.title: Rocket Devastator
rocket-devastator.description: The Rocket Devastator is a medium Automaton and specialized variant of the Devastator equipped with shoulder-mounted Rocket Pods and a double-barreled Fusion Assault Cannon. It attacks Helldivers with four-rocket salvos capable of striking targets behind cover while using its arm cannon between volleys. Rocket Devastators carry a limited supply of rockets and can reload their Rocket Pods once before relying entirely on their Fusion Assault Cannon. They commonly appear in patrols, Bot Drops, Automaton Outposts, objectives, and Minor Places of Interest.

scout-strider.title: Scout Strider
scout-strider.description: The Scout Strider is an armored Automaton reconnaissance walker operated by a single Trooper. Armed with a Heavy Fusion Repeater, it advances rapidly on Helldivers and fires three-round bursts while its frontal armor protects the pilot from small-arms fire. Scout Striders appear in patrols, Bot Drops, Automaton Outposts, objectives, and Minor Places of Interest. On the highest difficulties, they are replaced by the more heavily armored Reinforced Scout Strider.

reinforced-scout-strider.title: Reinforced Scout Strider
reinforced-scout-strider.description: The Reinforced Scout Strider is an upgraded and significantly more dangerous variant of the Scout Strider. Its Trooper pilot is completely enclosed by additional armor, eliminating the exposed pilot weakness of the standard model. It is armed with a Heavy Fusion Repeater and four heavy rockets capable of inflicting devastating explosive damage. Reinforced Scout Striders begin appearing on Impossible difficulty, replacing standard Scout Striders, and can be encountered in patrols, Bot Drops, Automaton Outposts, objectives, and Minor Places of Interest.

hulk.title: Hulk
hulk.description: Hulks are large, heavily armored Automaton war machines built to deliver overwhelming heavy firepower. Rather than representing a single weapon configuration, the Hulk chassis is fielded in several specialized variants, including the Hulk Bruiser, Hulk Scorcher, and Hulk Obliterator. Additional modified Hulks are deployed by Automaton subfactions such as the Jet Brigade and Incineration Corps.

hulk-bruiser.title: Hulk Bruiser
hulk-bruiser.description: The Hulk Bruiser is a heavily armored Automaton war machine built for ranged combat. It carries a Fusion Autocannon on one arm and a Rotary Munition Launcher on the other, allowing it to unleash sustained cannon fire and seven-rocket salvos at Helldivers. Hulk Bruisers can appear in patrols, Bot Drops, Automaton Outposts, objectives, Minor Places of Interest, and Bulk Fabricators. On planets controlled by the Jet Brigade, they are replaced by a specialized variant equipped with a Heavy Jump Pack.

hulk-scorcher.title: Hulk Scorcher
hulk-scorcher.description: The Hulk Scorcher is a heavily armored Automaton war machine specialized for close-quarters combat. It is armed with a Heavy Flamethrower on its left arm and a Heavy Rotary Saw on its right, aggressively pursuing Helldivers before sweeping them with fire or attacking at melee range. Hulk Scorchers can appear in patrols, Bot Drops, Automaton Outposts, objectives, Minor Places of Interest, and Bulk Fabricators. On Jet Brigade-controlled planets, they are replaced by a specialized variant equipped with a Heavy Jump Pack.

hulk-obliterator.title: Hulk Obliterator
hulk-obliterator.description: The Hulk Obliterator is a heavily armored Automaton war machine specialized for rocket bombardment. It carries a Revolving Munition Launcher on each arm and alternates between them to fire three-rocket salvos at Helldivers. Unlike other Hulk variants, the Obliterator is encountered specifically during Eliminate Automaton Hulks missions on Medium difficulty, where it serves as the mission's designated Hulk target.

hulk-firebomber.title: Hulk Firebomber
hulk-firebomber.description: The Hulk Firebomber is a heavily modified Hulk fielded by the Incineration Corps. Built around incendiary warfare, it carries a Rotary Phosphorus Launcher and Heavy Flamethrower. The Firebomber can launch phosphorus shells over terrain and cover, creating lingering areas of fire before closing the distance and attacking with its flamethrower. It appears on Incineration Corps-controlled battlefields beginning on Challenging difficulty.

annihilator-tank.title: Annihilator Tank
annihilator-tank.description: The Annihilator Tank is a massive armored Automaton combat vehicle equipped with a Fusion Battle Cannon, coaxial Fusion Cycler, and hull-mounted Heavy Fusion Repeater. It combines devastating long-range cannon fire with rapid fusion weaponry and can appear in patrols, Bot Drops, Automaton Outposts, Fortresses, and other defended positions. The Annihilator serves as the basis for several specialized Automaton tank variants.

shredder-tank.title: Shredder Tank
shredder-tank.description: The Shredder Tank is an Automaton tank variant that replaces the Annihilator Tank's main cannon with a quad-linked Heavy Fusion Cycler turret. Designed to overwhelm infantry with sustained fire, it can unleash short precision bursts or sweep its weapons across an area. Shredder Tanks can deploy through Bot Drops, patrol Automaton territory, and guard Outposts, Fortresses, and other strategic positions.

barrager-tank.title: Barrager Tank
barrager-tank.description: The Barrager Tank, also known as the Rocket Tank, is an Automaton tank variant armed with a Heavy Multiple Rocket Launch System. It fires three-rocket volleys directly at nearby Helldivers or raises its launcher to bombard more distant targets like mobile artillery. Barrager Tanks begin appearing on Suicide Mission difficulty and may replace Annihilator or Shredder Tanks in high-intensity Automaton operations.

gunship.title: Gunship
gunship.description: The Gunship is a flying Automaton combat vehicle armed with a Heavy Fusion Cycler and rockets. Gunships maneuver above the battlefield while tracking and attacking Helldivers from the air. They are primarily produced by Gunship Facilities and can also appear in aerial patrols under certain battlefield conditions. Their combination of mobility, rockets, and sustained fusion fire makes them one of the Automaton Legion's principal aerial threats.

factory-strider.title: Factory Strider
factory-strider.description: The Factory Strider is a massive quadrupedal Automaton war machine that combines heavy firepower with the ability to manufacture troops directly on the battlefield. It is armed with twin Fusion Gatling Guns and a Fusion Repeater Cannon capable of firing explosive three-round bursts. The Factory Strider periodically deploys squads of Devastators from its underside, effectively functioning as both a heavily armored combat vehicle and a mobile Automaton factory.

dropship.title: Dropship
dropship.description: The Dropship is an unarmed Automaton transport aircraft responsible for rapidly deploying reinforcements during Bot Drops. When Automaton forces successfully call for assistance, Dropships arrive carrying infantry, walkers, Hulks, tanks, and even Factory Striders depending on the reinforcement group. The aircraft itself carries no offensive weapons and exists primarily to transport Automaton units directly onto the battlefield.

gunship-facility.title: Gunship Facility
gunship-facility.description: The Gunship Facility is a heavily fortified Automaton production structure dedicated to manufacturing Gunships. While operational, each facility continuously launches additional Gunships whenever Helldivers remain nearby, allowing the number of hostile aircraft to rapidly increase. Helldivers encounter Gunship Facilities as optional objectives and must demolish the structures with sufficiently powerful explosives such as a Hellbomb.

automaton-fabricator.title: Automaton Fabricator
automaton-fabricator.description: The Automaton Fabricator is a production structure found throughout Automaton Outposts. Standard Fabricators continuously deploy Troopers and their variants until their available forces are exhausted or the structure is destroyed. Larger Bulk Fabricators found in urban Automaton positions can manufacture substantially heavier units, including Devastators, Berserkers, Scout Striders, Hulks, tanks, and War Striders.

stratagem-jammer.title: Stratagem Jammer
stratagem-jammer.description: The Stratagem Jammer is an Automaton electronic warfare installation designed to prevent Helldivers from calling most Stratagems within its area of influence. Its jamming field extends approximately 150 meters and can prevent access to vital support such as weapons, airstrikes, orbital attacks, resupply, and manually called reinforcements. Helldivers can infiltrate the installation and use its terminal to temporarily disable the jammer before destroying the structure.

detector-tower.title: Detector Tower
detector-tower.description: The Detector Tower is an Automaton surveillance installation designed to locate hostile forces and summon reinforcements. Its distinctive rotating scanner searches the surrounding battlefield for Helldivers, and once a target is detected the installation can repeatedly call Bot Drops to defend the area. Detector Towers are commonly encountered as optional objectives and can also appear within heavily fortified Automaton positions.

cannon-turret.title: Cannon Turret
cannon-turret.description: The Cannon Turret is a heavily armored Automaton defensive weapon consisting of an Annihilator-style turret mounted on a fortified pillar. Armed with a Fusion Battle Cannon, it can engage Helldivers and vehicles at long range with powerful explosive fire. Cannon Turrets defend Automaton Outposts, Fortresses, Orbital Cannons, and other strategic positions, with a glowing heatsink on the rear serving as a major vulnerability.

mortar-emplacement.title: Mortar Emplacement
mortar-emplacement.description: The Mortar Emplacement is an Automaton artillery installation found within fortified outposts. Once nearby Automaton forces identify a hostile target, the emplacement launches heavy explosive shells in high arcs toward Helldiver positions. Multiple mortars can operate together to bombard an area, forcing Helldivers to remain mobile until the artillery battery is destroyed.

anti-air-emplacement.title: Anti-Air Emplacement
anti-air-emplacement.description: The Anti-Air Emplacement is an Automaton air-defense installation designed to deny Helldivers access to Eagle support. While an active emplacement is nearby, Eagle Stratagems are obstructed within approximately 150 meters. Anti-Air positions contain multiple heavily armored gun emplacements and must be destroyed before normal Eagle operations can safely resume within the affected area.

automaton-outpost.title: Automaton Outpost
automaton-outpost.description: Automaton Outposts are fortified positions established throughout Automaton-controlled territory. They contain Fabricators that manufacture additional troops and may be protected by infantry, heavy units, emplacements, and defensive structures. Outposts range from small installations to heavily defended bases, while the largest Automaton Fortresses contain six Fabricators and extensive defenses such as Cannon Turrets, Bunker Turrets, MG Emplacements, and sometimes a Detector Tower.

war-strider.title: War Strider
war-strider.description: The War Strider is a large, heavily armored bipedal Automaton walker designed for sustained battlefield fire support. It is armed with paired Fusion Culverins and Grenade Projectors, allowing it to bombard distant Helldivers with arcing explosive salvos while delivering powerful bursts of fusion fire. War Striders begin appearing on Extreme difficulty and can deploy from Bot Drops, patrol Automaton territory, defend Outposts, or emerge from Bulk Fabricators.

bulk-fabricator.title: Bulk Fabricator
bulk-fabricator.description: The Bulk Fabricator is a massive Automaton production structure found in urban Automaton Outposts. Unlike standard Fabricators that primarily deploy Troopers and their variants, Bulk Fabricators manufacture heavier combat units including Devastators, Berserkers, Scout Striders, Hulks, tanks, and War Striders. Their ability to continuously produce heavy units makes them a major priority when assaulting Automaton-controlled cities.

bunker-turret.title: Bunker Turret
bunker-turret.description: The Bunker Turret is an Automaton defensive weapon installed around heavily fortified positions such as Command Bunkers and Fortresses. These automated weapons protect important Automaton installations by engaging approaching Helldivers with sustained fire and form part of the layered defenses surrounding high-value Automaton strongholds.

automaton-mg-emplacement.title: Automaton MG Emplacement
automaton-mg-emplacement.description: Automaton MG Emplacements are crew-operated defensive weapons commonly positioned around Outposts and other Automaton installations. Two major variants exist: a single-barreled Light Fusion Cycler with a high rate of fire and a double-barreled Heavy Fusion Repeater that fires more powerful bursts. Both use protective gunshields to shelter their operators, and abandoned emplacements can be operated by Helldivers.

enemy-bio-processors.title: Enemy Bio-Processors
enemy-bio-processors.description: Enemy Bio-Processors are Automaton installations involved in the synthesis of organic plasma. They are located inside defended Automaton Outposts and are commonly protected by Automaton troops and at least one Fabricator. Super Earth considers the facilities important enough to designate their destruction as an optional battlefield objective, ordering Helldivers to eliminate the Bio-Processors by any available means.

transmission-antenna.title: Transmission Antenna
transmission-antenna.description: The Transmission Antenna is an Automaton communications structure used to broadcast propaganda and other transmissions across occupied territory. Helldivers encounter these installations as objectives during operations against the Automatons and are ordered to destroy them to disrupt enemy communications and broadcasts.

fuel-silo.title: Fuel Silo
fuel-silo.description: Fuel Silos are Automaton supply structures used to store reserves supporting their war machine. They can be found at enemy supply bases alongside other logistical infrastructure. Helldivers are tasked with destroying these fuel reserves during sabotage operations to disrupt Automaton supply networks and reduce their ability to sustain military operations.

ammo-stockpile.title: Ammo Stockpile
ammo-stockpile.description: Ammo Stockpiles are collections of munitions stored at Automaton supply bases and military positions. Super Earth identifies these reserves as important components of the Automaton war effort, and Helldivers are frequently ordered to destroy them during sabotage operations. Eliminating the stockpiles disrupts the flow of ammunition supporting Automaton forces.

assault-raider.title: Assault Raider
assault-raider.description: The Assault Raider is a light Automaton specialized for aggressive close-quarters combat and associated with the Jet Brigade. Equipped with a Jump Pack, Fusion Pistol, Heat Blade, and grenades, it can rapidly leap toward Helldivers before engaging at close range. Assault Raiders can appear in patrols, Bot Drops, Automaton Outposts, objectives, and Fabricators.

jet-brigade-commissar.title: Jet Brigade Commissar
jet-brigade-commissar.description: The Jet Brigade Commissar is a modified Commissar equipped with a Jump Pack. It retains the Fusion Pistol, Heat Blade, grenades, and leadership role of the standard Commissar while gaining the ability to rapidly leap across the battlefield. Jet Brigade Commissars lead patrols, arrive through Bot Drops, guard Automaton positions, and use their enhanced mobility to quickly close the distance with Helldivers.

jet-brigade-trooper.title: Jet Brigade Trooper
jet-brigade-trooper.description: The Jet Brigade Trooper is a modified Trooper equipped with a Jump Pack that allows it to rapidly leap across the battlefield. It retains the Fusion SMG and grenades of the standard Trooper but uses its increased mobility to aggressively close the distance with Helldivers. Its volatile Jump Pack can explode when damaged, potentially killing the Trooper and injuring nearby units.

jet-brigade-mg-raider.title: Jet Brigade MG Raider
jet-brigade-mg-raider.description: The Jet Brigade MG Raider is a modified MG Raider equipped with a Jump Pack. It retains the Light Fusion Repeater and grenades of the standard MG Raider while gaining the ability to rapidly leap toward Helldivers. The Jump Pack is volatile and can explode when damaged, turning groups of Jet Brigade infantry into potential chain-reaction hazards.

jet-brigade-devastator.title: Jet Brigade Devastator
jet-brigade-devastator.description: The Jet Brigade Devastator is a modified Devastator repainted and equipped with a Jump Pack. It retains the Fusion Assault Cannon and heavy construction of the standard Devastator while gaining enough mobility to leap large distances and aggressively reposition against Helldivers. Destroying its Jump Pack can trigger an explosion capable of damaging the Devastator and nearby units.

jet-brigade-hulk-bruiser.title: Jet Brigade Hulk Bruiser
jet-brigade-hulk-bruiser.description: The Jet Brigade Hulk Bruiser is a modified Hulk Bruiser fitted with a massive Heavy Jump Pack. It retains the Fusion Autocannon and Rotary Munition Launcher of the standard Bruiser while gaining the ability to leap great distances to pursue or reposition against Helldivers. The Heavy Jump Pack covers the Hulk's rear vent and can itself become a dangerous explosive target when destroyed.

jet-brigade-hulk-scorcher.title: Jet Brigade Hulk Scorcher
jet-brigade-hulk-scorcher.description: The Jet Brigade Hulk Scorcher is a modified Hulk Scorcher equipped with a massive Heavy Jump Pack. It retains the Heavy Flamethrower and Rotary Saw of the standard Scorcher but uses its enhanced mobility to rapidly close the distance with Helldivers before attacking at close range. The Heavy Jump Pack covers its rear vent and allows the Scorcher to repeatedly leap after targets attempting to escape.

pyro-trooper.title: Pyro Trooper
pyro-trooper.description: The Pyro Trooper is a light Automaton fielded by the Incineration Corps and specialized for close-range incendiary combat. It carries a Portable Flamer, White Phosphorus Grenades, and a backpack-mounted fuel tank. Pyro Troopers aggressively advance into flamethrower range and can use incendiary grenades to force Helldivers from cover. Their fuel tanks are highly volatile and can explode when damaged, potentially harming nearby units.

incendiary-rocket-raider.title: Incendiary Rocket Raider
incendiary-rocket-raider.description: The Incendiary Rocket Raider is a light Automaton fielded by the Incineration Corps. Unlike the standard Rocket Raider, it carries a Portable Fusion Cannon that fires a powerful single fusion bolt before recharging. It also carries White Phosphorus Grenades and can launch signal flares to summon Bot Drop reinforcements. Incendiary Rocket Raiders typically engage from medium range while attempting to keep their distance from approaching Helldivers.

incendiary-mg-devastator.title: Incendiary MG Devastator
incendiary-mg-devastator.description: The Incendiary MG Devastator is an Incineration Corps variant of the Heavy Devastator. It carries a large ballistic shield and replaces the standard Fusion Repeater with a Fusion Conflagrator that fires incendiary projectiles capable of igniting targets. Although its weapon fires more slowly than that of a standard Heavy Devastator, individual hits can inflict dangerous burning effects as the unit steadily advances behind its shield.

conflagration-devastator.title: Conflagration Devastator
conflagration-devastator.description: The Conflagration Devastator is an Incineration Corps Devastator variant equipped for close- and medium-range incendiary combat. It carries a large ballistic shield and an incendiary fusion shotgun capable of setting Helldivers on fire while suppressing them with powerful bursts. Its shield protects much of its body from frontal attacks, allowing the unit to steadily advance while forcing Helldivers away from exposed positions.

radical.title: Radical
radical.description: The Radical is a cybernetically enhanced human soldier fielded by the Cyborg Legion. Specialized for aggressive close-quarters combat, Radicals use Hydrogen-infused Plasma Scatterguns, smoke grenades, augmented limbs, and so-called techno-martial arts. They aggressively pursue Helldivers, using smoke to conceal their approach before attacking with powerful shotgun blasts and cybernetically enhanced melee strikes. Radicals can appear on all difficulties wherever the Cyborg Legion is present.

agitator.title: Agitator
agitator.description: The Agitator is a cybernetically enhanced field commander serving the Cyborg Legion. Armed with a Plasma Charger, grenades, and augmented limbs, Agitators generally fight from range while directing nearby Automaton troops. Automatons placed under an Agitator's command gain increased movement speed, identifiable by their glowing yellow eyes. Agitators can also overcharge their Plasma Chargers for more powerful explosive shots and use cybernetic martial arts when forced into close combat.

vox-engine.title: Vox Engine
vox-engine.description: The Vox Engine is a massive, heavily armored Cyborg war machine and one of the most formidable units fielded alongside the Automatons. Moving on enormous tracks, it carries paired Plasma Macro-Culverins, Plasma Duster Miniguns, and Icarus Missile Launcher Pods while broadcasting Cyborg propaganda through its loudspeakers. Vox Engines appear on Cyborg Legion worlds beginning on Suicide Mission difficulty and replace Factory Striders in several encounters where Cyborg forces are present.

cyborg-megafactory.title: Cyborg Megafactory
cyborg-megafactory.description: Cyborg Megafactories are enormous industrial complexes used by the Cyborg Legion to manufacture new Cyborg forces. After the return of the Cyborgs, Megafactories became strategically important targets as the Legion attempted to expand its production capacity beyond Cyberstan. These facilities can spread to additional planets and significantly strengthen Cyborg resistance if allowed to remain operational.

cyborg-production-unit.title: Cyborg Production Unit
cyborg-production-unit.description: The Cyborg Production Unit is a massive bio-synthetic manufacturing system located within Cyborg Megafactories and used to produce new Cyborgs. The units are structurally resistant to conventional demolition, requiring Helldivers to sabotage them from within. During Halt Cyborg Production operations, Helldivers flood the production system with volatile hydrogen and destabilize the facility until the unit self-destructs.
